description: Internal enterprise operating system prioritizing CLARITY, CONTEXT, and ACTION. Dense but legible, highly professional, sober, and decision-oriented.

rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for all financial numbers, KPIs, timestamps, and audit logs.
Use uppercase labels with tracking for section headers and statuses to enhance the premium systemic feel.
Never center-align paragraphs, inputs, or dense content.
No pure black (#000000). Use deep tinted navy/black for backgrounds.
Gold (#F59E0B) is strictly for emphasizing CTAs, alerts, and critical actions. Do not use for large fills.
Violet (#7C3AED) is for primary active states, selected items, and structural highlights.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
No large gradient backgrounds. Maintain a solid, dense, decision-focused look.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (MODE B: High Density Grid)
rules: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12 for fine-grained control.
Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 to gap-6).
Card Padding: p-4 to p-6 inside cards. Use tight density to maximize information display.
Multi-panel layout: Utilize h-full to stretch children, ensuring strict optical alignment.
Left Sidebar Navigation: Fixed w-64 (or collapsed w-16). Main content should occupy the remaining width.

surfaces.cards: Use 'Flat Solid' strategy. bg-[#13141C] with a subtle 1px border border-[#252633] and minimal shadow. border-radius: 4px (rounded). NO glassmorphism for this dense data OS.
surfaces.headers: Solid background with a 1px border-b. No transparent headers.
surfaces.modals_dropdowns: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds. Must have solid background (bg-card) with z-50 and border.

interactive.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (4px). Primary actions in Violet or Gold. Text must change on hover. Hover states must be explicitly defined (e.g. hover:bg-violet-700 hover:text-white).
interactive.forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Input backgrounds must match the card or be slightly darker.
interactive.data_tables: Dense rows. Text left-aligned except for numbers/currency which are right-aligned. Hover effects on rows (bg-white/5).

charts.styling: Use primary violet and accent gold for data points. Strip out heavy grid lines, keep axes minimal. For timelines, use AreaChart with subtle opacity gradients. Use Shadcn chart components.

icons.usage: Use Duotone or Regular weights. Keep icons small (16px - 20px) to match dense UI.

avatar_male.description: Professional male avatar for People OS / Profile.

avatar_female.description: Professional female avatar for Work Graph / Profile.

background_login.description: Subtle dark purple abstract background, only use at low opacity behind login or command center hero areas.

rules: Minimalist and functional. Use micro-interactions (200ms ease) for hover and active states.
Entrance animations for data lists: subtle staggered fade-in via Framer Motion.
No excessive scaling or bouncy animations. It is an enterprise OS.
Focus states must use ring-2 ring-violet-500 offset-2 offset-black.
Color-blind friendly data visualization.
All interactive elements must be keyboard accessible.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='approve-decision-btn').
Kebab-case, role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use transparent backgrounds for any modals, dropdowns, or floating navigation. They must have solid dark backgrounds.
Ensure the Command Center, People OS, Finance OS, Legal OS, and CVL Brain panels are constructed as dense grid modules.
Every recommended action in the OS must visibly show 'Approve', 'Reject', or 'Escalate' pathways using the gold accent.
Install required dependencies: yarn add recharts @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion sonner lucide-react
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. The UI must feel authoritative, tactile, and highly deliberate.
Implement the 'Bento Grid Protocol' accurately. Overcome standard boxy layouts by varying span sizes for KPIs vs. Charts.
Create depth through layering surfaces (e.g., sidebar darker than main content card), not heavy drop shadows.
Do not use generic emoji characters for icons; use @phosphor-icons/react.
No universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Never center-align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
